name: skillret-readonly-agent-5x500-v1
purpose: Deterministic non-overlapping SkillRet read-only agent sample chunks.
algorithm: Exclude prior GPT-5.5 30-query sample; group by primary expected skill major/sub taxonomy and single-vs-multi target qrel count; allocate 2500 queries proportionally with largest remainder; shuffle within strata by sha256(seed, stratum, query id); interleave selected strata by normalized within-stratum rank; split into five contiguous 500-query chunks.

execution.retryPolicy: Rows that reached a lower exploratory cap are rerun once under the benchmark cap and replaced before reporting.
